summary: Embraer S.A. filed a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) announcing a change to its American Depositary Share ratio, from one ADS representing four common shares to one ADS representing one common share. Record date is November 9, 2026, with holders receiving three additional ADSs per ADS held after the close on November 13, 2026, and split-adjusted trading beginning November 16, 2026. JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. acts as depositary. No new common shares are issued and ticker EMBJ is unchanged, so this routine administrative ratio change carries no deal or event-driven angle.
